## Joseki

This is the famous Great Slope Joseki (aka Taisha). Once attractive and complicated, it has now been reduced and simplified because of AI. (See [Jiang Weijie, commenting a Samsung Cup game: Shin Jinseo v. Xie Erhao](https://gochn2en.net/wp/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/Sumsang_cup_Shin_Xie.pdf).)

White may play at <B:P16> or **Tenuki** to avoid complications. These are compromise moves, so slight disadvantages are inevitable. There are compromise moves even after attaching at <A:Q15>.

<C:O17> and <D:P17> are old joseki and are simpler than the current moves.
